findings.title: Signal has major reference plane gap
findings.description: Net Net-(D1-A) has 0% reference plane coverage over 13.1mm of routing. Return current must detour around the gap, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. On a 2-layer board the gaps are usually where back-side tracks cut the pour into islands — stitch the two pours together (draw-pcb stitch_zones) so return current has a way across. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (IN L-G-R) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J1. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J2. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: Via stitching may be insufficient
findings.description: Board has 0 vias across 1092 mm² (no vias detected). For the highest frequency on this board (150 MHz), λ/20 stitching requires ≤48mm spacing.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias at ≤48mm intervals, especially at board edges and near connectors.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (42×26mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1701 MHz; (0,1) at 2749 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
